title: Cost estimates
one_line: Estimate what a model call costs and check it against a budget.
verified_against: Rust core and native binding tests run the real calculator against its bundled price table; the facade tests use a mock core. Prices are a snapshot, not fetched live.
snippet:
from briefcase.cost import CostCalculator

c = CostCalculator()
est = c.estimate_cost("gpt-4", input_tokens=1000, output_tokens=500)
print(est.total_cost)
